speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The loaf is a finger and a half short of the notch. The price is a penny. I am not paying more, and I am not pretending it grew.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A finger and a half. I can see it. I am not arguing the notch.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: You were walking again before you went up the road. I heard the floor. It was not a comedy.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That was a part. An old man. Forty lines. He sits down at the end of them.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Forty lines and he sits. That is a length, Master Shakespeare. It is not yet a play. Who is punished.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nobody is punished in the telling I will give at a table. He is tired, and he is believed, and he stops.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then I will not rule on it. Bring me a plot with a sin in it, and I will tell you if the sin is punished. Mark me.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The shuttle goes, and comes, and goes. A weaver thinks with his feet, as you do. I heard the feet. I did not hear a song.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There was no song. The king is upstairs, and he is not this dinner. This dinner is three pence, and the loaf.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The three pence stays for the board you are sitting. The penny is the loaf's. The loaf is the baker's fault, not mine.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Does the old man have a wife to wash the shirt. At home the shirt would be in by now.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I did not write her the washing. Do not put her in. I am not speaking a side twice so the copper can have it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I was not asking for a side. I was asking who does the shirt. A man who sits down after forty lines has a shirt.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Alse. The shirt is not the play. Sit. Eat the short end. You like the crust.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: In the loom a short measure is still the penny, if the penny was agreed. Your baker agreed the penny. The wheat did not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The wheat is not at this table. Thursday the same old man goes again, and after him a dance that is not mine. Today the play is done when the afternoon is done.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A dance in my kitchen is a different rent. Keep it at the playhouse. Gib has the stool. You will not move him for a jig.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not jigging. The slippers are Thursday, and they are Kemp's. I am in for the bowl.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is the book still with the French pot. You came home yesterday smelling of cheese, and the cheese is not ours.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The book came back this morning. The cheese was the end of Sunday. I am not going over Paul's again this week.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. Field keeps his own door. I keep this one. You will be quiet after nine, dance or no dance.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will be at the loom before you are quiet. I will shut my door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Shut it. I have a page that is not a duke. I will walk it where the floor is mine.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The broom comes. You know the broom. Pass the loaf. The notch is still ahead of it. It is not a thumb. It is not on a pan.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Passed. Gib has looked at the end and decided against it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The three pence is spent by sitting. The penny is not my argument.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the argument is over. Eat. A man who has spoken forty lines can manage a short loaf.
